description: This Java source file defines the JpaDashboardDao class, which implements data access operations for Dashboard entities in a SQL database within the Thingsboard project. It includes methods for counting, retrieving, and listing dashboards based on tenant and other criteria.

classes.name: JpaDashboardDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for Dashboard entities, providing methods to interact with the database for CRUD operations and queries related to dashboards.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the DashboardEntity.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Provides the JpaRepository instance for DashboardEntity.

methods.name: countByTenantId
methods.description: Counts dashboards associated with a specific tenant ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndExternalId
methods.description: Finds a dashboard by tenant ID and external ID.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves dashboards for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Gets external ID corresponding to an internal dashboard ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndTitle
methods.description: Finds dashboards by tenant ID and title.

methods.name: findIdsByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves paginated dashboard IDs for a tenant.

methods.name: findAllIds
methods.description: Retrieves all dashboard IDs with pagination.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all dashboards for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Finds the next batch of DashboardFields starting from a given ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is DASHBOARD.
